scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: Hard gates pass, but candidate 03 preserves source-like instance size and nearest-neighbor spacing slightly more closely while retaining essentially the same clustering, tissue geometry and quota.

All hard gates pass and the mask review shows coherent moderate tumor-boundary growth. Candidate 03 most closely preserves source instance size and nearest-neighbor spacing with essentially source-matched Ripley clustering.
decisions.tissue_geometry: Tumor expansion follows existing external tumor-stroma interfaces across the planned connected regions and preserves neighboring immune and non-target structures.
decisions.nucleus_layout: Thirty class-1 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Candidate 03 has source-relative NND 0.992 and Ripley K24 1.011.
decisions.coupling: Added nuclei occupy the authorized expanded tumor footprint; boundary binding, seam continuity, quota and compatibility gates pass.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and native structures outside joint support remain preserved without partial-instance, overlap or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: This is mask-only annotation-conditioned evidence in an uncalibrated research envelope, not generated-H&E or clinical validation.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 03 as the single mask-condition handoff.
